can_do_en: I can send a parcel abroad, choose between air and sea mail after asking how long and how much, and ask where the ATM is and whether my card costs a fee.

dialogue.speaker: 郵局人員
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄒㄧㄚˋ ㄧ ㄨㄟˋ ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄌㄞˊ

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 你好，這個包裹我要寄到美國。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄏㄠˇ ㄓㄜˋ ˙ㄍㄜ ㄅㄠ ㄍㄨㄛˇ ㄨㄛˇ ㄧㄠˋ ㄐㄧˋ ㄉㄠˋ ㄇㄟˇ ㄍㄨㄛˊ
dialogue.en: Hi, I'd like to send this parcel to the US.

dialogue.speaker: 郵局人員
dialogue.zh: 好，請放上來。兩公斤……你要寄空運還是海運？
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄏㄠˇ ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄈㄤˋ ㄕㄤˋ ㄌㄞˊ ㄌㄧㄤˇ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄐㄧㄣ ㄋㄧˇ ㄧㄠˋ ㄐㄧˋ ㄎㄨㄥ ㄩㄣˋ ㄏㄞˊ ㄕˋ ㄏㄞˇ ㄩㄣˋ
dialogue.en: OK, put it up here, please. Two kilos… Do you want to send it by air or by sea?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄎㄨㄥ ㄩㄣˋ ㄒㄩ ㄧㄠˋ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄐㄧㄡˇ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄕㄠˇ ㄑㄧㄢˊ
dialogue.en: How long does airmail take? How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: 郵局人員
dialogue.zh: 空運差不多一個星期就會到，一千多塊。海運比較便宜，可是要兩、三個月。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄎㄨㄥ ㄩㄣˋ ㄔㄚ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄧ ˙ㄍㄜ ㄒㄧㄥ ㄑㄧˊ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄉㄠˋ ㄧ ㄑㄧㄢ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄎㄨㄞˋ ㄏㄞˇ ㄩㄣˋ ㄅㄧˇ ㄐㄧㄠˋ ㄆㄧㄢˊ ㄧˊ ㄎㄜˇ ㄕˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄌㄧㄤˇ ㄙㄢ ˙ㄍㄜ ㄩㄝˋ
dialogue.en: Airmail gets there in about a week, for a little over a thousand dollars. Sea mail is cheaper, but it takes two or three months.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 那我寄空運好了。我媽媽下個月生日。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄋㄚˋ ㄨㄛˇ ㄐㄧˋ ㄎㄨㄥ ㄩㄣˋ ㄏㄠˇ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄚ ˙ㄇㄚ ㄒㄧㄚˋ ˙ㄍㄜ ㄩㄝˋ ㄕㄥ ㄖˋ
dialogue.en: Then I'll go with airmail. My mom's birthday is next month.

dialogue.speaker: 郵局人員
dialogue.zh: 好，請先填這張單子，地址跟電話要寫清楚喔。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄏㄠˇ ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄒㄧㄢ ㄊㄧㄢˊ ㄓㄜˋ ㄓㄤ ㄉㄢ ˙ㄗ ㄉㄧˋ ㄓˇ ㄍㄣ ㄉㄧㄢˋ ㄏㄨㄚˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄒㄧㄝˇ ㄑㄧㄥ ㄔㄨˇ ㄛ
dialogue.en: OK, please fill in this form first. Write the address and phone number clearly, OK?

dialogue.speaker: 郵局人員
dialogue.zh: 裡面是什麼東西，你有寫嗎？
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄌㄧˇ ㄇㄧㄢˋ ㄕˋ ㄕㄣˊ ˙ㄇㄜ ㄉㄨㄥ ˙ㄒㄧ ㄋㄧˇ ㄧㄡˇ ㄒㄧㄝˇ ˙ㄇㄚ
dialogue.en: Did you write down what's inside?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 有，衣服跟茶葉。對了，你們這裡有提款機嗎？我想領錢。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄧㄡˇ ㄧ ˙ㄈㄨ ㄍㄣ ㄔㄚˊ ㄧㄝˋ ㄉㄨㄟˋ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄋㄧˇ ˙ㄇㄣ ㄓㄜˋ ㄌㄧˇ ㄧㄡˇ ㄊㄧˊ ㄎㄨㄢˇ ㄐㄧ ˙ㄇㄚ ㄨㄛˇ ㄒㄧㄤˇ ㄌㄧㄥˇ ㄑㄧㄢˊ
dialogue.en: Yes: clothes and tea. Oh, by the way, do you have an ATM here? I'd like to take out some money.

dialogue.speaker: 郵局人員
dialogue.zh: 有，在門口旁邊。你的卡是郵局的嗎？別家銀行的卡也可以用，可是要手續費喔。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄧㄡˇ ㄗㄞˋ ㄇㄣˊ ㄎㄡˇ ㄆㄤˊ ㄅㄧㄢ ㄋㄧˇ ˙ㄉㄜ ㄎㄚˇ ㄕˋ ㄧㄡˊ ㄐㄩˊ ˙ㄉㄜ ˙ㄇㄚ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄧㄣˊ ㄏㄤˊ ˙ㄉㄜ ㄎㄚˇ ㄧㄝˇ ㄎㄜˇ ㄧˇ ㄩㄥˋ ㄎㄜˇ ㄕˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄕㄡˇ ㄒㄩˋ ㄈㄟˋ ㄛ
dialogue.en: Yes, next to the entrance. Is your card a post office card? Other banks' cards work too, but there's a fee.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 是郵局的。我的帳戶是上個月在這裡開的。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄕˋ ㄧㄡˊ ㄐㄩˊ ˙ㄉㄜ ㄨㄛˇ ˙ㄉㄜ ㄓㄤˋ ㄏㄨˋ ㄕˋ ㄕㄤˋ ˙ㄍㄜ ㄩㄝˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄓㄜˋ ㄌㄧˇ ㄎㄞ ˙ㄉㄜ
dialogue.en: It's a post office card. I opened my account here last month.

dialogue.speaker: 郵局人員
dialogue.zh: 那就不用手續費。一共一千一百八十塊。這張給你，用上面的號碼，可以在網路上查包裹到哪裡了。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄋㄚˋ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄩㄥˋ ㄕㄡˇ ㄒㄩˋ ㄈㄟˋ ㄧ ㄍㄨㄥˋ ㄧ ㄑㄧㄢ ㄧ ㄅㄞˇ ㄅㄚ ㄕˊ ㄎㄨㄞˋ ㄓㄜˋ ㄓㄤ ㄍㄟˇ ㄋㄧˇ ㄩㄥˋ ㄕㄤˋ ㄇㄧㄢˋ ˙ㄉㄜ ㄏㄠˋ ㄇㄚˇ ㄎㄜˇ ㄧˇ ㄗㄞˋ ㄨㄤˇ ㄌㄨˋ ㄕㄤˋ ㄔㄚˊ ㄅㄠ ㄍㄨㄛˇ ㄉㄠˋ ㄋㄚˇ ㄌㄧˇ ˙ㄌㄜ
dialogue.en: Then there's no fee. That's 1,180 dollars altogether. This slip is for you: with the number on it, you can check online where your parcel is.

vocab.en: to send (by mail); 寄到 + place: send to
to withdraw money, take out cash
(bank) account; 開帳戶 open an account
the internet; 在網路上 online

grammar.note_en: 這個包裹我要寄到美國: 到 + place right after the verb says where the parcel will end up. Nothing goes between 寄 and 到. You'll say it at every post office counter: 寄到台北, 寄到日本.
The clerk asks 你要寄空運還是海運？: 還是 offers two choices, so the question needs no 嗎. Answer with the one you pick: 寄空運.
Opening the account is already known; 是上個月在這裡開的 puts the focus on when and where it happened. 是 goes before the detail, 的 at the end, and there is no 了.

pronunciation.note_en: Keep ㄢ and ㄤ apart: 單子 ㄉㄢ ˙ㄗ and 便宜 ㄆㄧㄢˊ ㄧˊ end with the tongue tip on the ridge behind the teeth; 帳戶 ㄓㄤˋ ㄏㄨˋ, 銀行 ㄧㄣˊ ㄏㄤˊ and 這張 ㄓㄜˋ ㄓㄤ end open, with the back of the tongue raised ("ahng"). Tone pair 2+2 (two rises): 郵局 ㄧㄡˊ ㄐㄩˊ and 銀行 ㄧㄣˊ ㄏㄤˊ. Let both syllables rise; don't let the second one fall. In 郵局 the ㄐㄩˊ needs rounded lips with the tongue held for ㄧ. 一共 is written ㄧ ㄍㄨㄥˋ but said ㄧˊ ㄍㄨㄥˋ, and 不用 is said ㄅㄨˊ ㄩㄥˋ.

comprehension.question_en: Where is Mark sending his parcel?

options_en: His mother's birthday is next month.
The clerk says sea mail is not possible.

comprehension.question_en: How long does sea mail take?
What else does Mark want to do at the post office?
options_en: Take out money from the ATM

comprehension.question_en: Why won't Mark pay an ATM fee?
options_en: His card is from the post office.
He pays the fee at the counter.

speaking.prompt_en: You're at a post office in Pingtung, sending a parcel home. Say where it's going, ask how long air and sea mail take and what they cost, pick one, say what's inside, and then ask whether there's an ATM.
speaking.prompt_zh: 你在屏東的郵局寄包裹回你的國家。請說要寄到哪裡，問空運跟海運要多久、多少錢，選一個，說裡面是什麼東西，再問郵局有沒有提款機。
checklist_en: said where the parcel goes with 寄到 + place
asked or answered an either/or question with 還是 (空運還是海運)
asked 需要多久？ and 多少錢？
asked 有提款機嗎？ or said 我想領錢
kept ㄢ (單子) and ㄤ (帳戶, 銀行) apart, and let both syllables of 郵局 rise

writing.prompt_en: Write a short LINE message (3–5 sentences) to a friend: you went to the post office today, what you sent and where to, whether you chose air or sea mail and why, and what you did afterwards.
writing.prompt_zh: 請寫一個短短的LINE訊息給朋友：你今天去郵局寄了什麼、寄到哪裡、寄空運還是海運、為什麼，還有寄好了以後做了什麼。
writing.model_zh: 我今天去郵局寄包裹到美國了，裡面是要送我媽媽的衣服跟茶葉。海運要兩、三個月，太慢了，所以我寄空運。空運比較貴，一千多塊，可是差不多一個星期就會到。寄好了，我就去提款機領錢。
writing.model_zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄐㄧㄣ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄑㄩˋ ㄧㄡˊ ㄐㄩˊ ㄐㄧˋ ㄅㄠ ㄍㄨㄛˇ ㄉㄠˋ ㄇㄟˇ ㄍㄨㄛˊ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄌㄧˇ ㄇㄧㄢˋ ㄕˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄙㄨㄥˋ ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄚ ˙ㄇㄚ ˙ㄉㄜ ㄧ ˙ㄈㄨ ㄍㄣ ㄔㄚˊ ㄧㄝˋ ㄏㄞˇ ㄩㄣˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄌㄧㄤˇ ㄙㄢ ˙ㄍㄜ ㄩㄝˋ ㄊㄞˋ ㄇㄢˋ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄙㄨㄛˇ ㄧˇ ㄨㄛˇ ㄐㄧˋ ㄎㄨㄥ ㄩㄣˋ ㄎㄨㄥ ㄩㄣˋ ㄅㄧˇ ㄐㄧㄠˋ ㄍㄨㄟˋ ㄧ ㄑㄧㄢ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄎㄨㄞˋ ㄎㄜˇ ㄕˋ ㄔㄚ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄧ ˙ㄍㄜ ㄒㄧㄥ ㄑㄧˊ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄉㄠˋ ㄐㄧˋ ㄏㄠˇ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄨㄛˇ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄑㄩˋ ㄊㄧˊ ㄎㄨㄢˇ ㄐㄧ ㄌㄧㄥˇ ㄑㄧㄢˊ

culture_en: Taiwan's post office, Chunghwa Post (中華郵政), also runs a savings bank: at the same counters you can mail a parcel or open an account (帳戶), and post offices, even in small towns, have ATMs (提款機). Taking cash out with another bank's card (跨行提款) costs a small fee (手續費). Outside a post office you'll see two mailboxes: the green one is for ordinary mail within Taiwan, and the red one is for prompt delivery (限時) and airmail.
